evidence: Reviewed the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx through openpyxl: Quality Checks row 4 requires 'No real spelling errors and nothing pasted in by mistake (author notes, TODOs, other machines? paths, contradictions)'; Internal Quality Checks row 4 agrees; Deterministic Checks rows 13?14 cover the finished brief and hygiene. Applied frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:17?19 and deterministic-checks.md:58,71?78. Read instruction.md and every one of the six environment/instructions notes in full, plus seed_data.json, environment/Dockerfile, task.toml and tests/app_context.md for contradiction checks. All task-relative citations below refer to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task. Manual spelling review found no real errors: behaviour, colouring, labelled and colours are valid British spellings, and JavaScript, TypeScript, WebAssembly and better-sqlite3 are correctly written names. Read-only Python scans found zero TODO/FIXME/XXX/CHANGE_ME/<placeholder>/lorem ipsum markers, author-machine paths, grader vocabulary, replacement characters/BOM/NUL or duplicate paragraphs (both within and across all seven public Markdown files). instruction.md contains 232 whitespace-separated words. Its line 5 says 'read the six notes'; six files exist and all four distinct referenced /instructions or /assets file paths resolve after punctuation is removed. instruction.md:1 ('No accounts or sign-in') agrees with overview.md:7, policy.md:3 and tests/app_context.md:8. behaviour.md:9 ('Give each run five seconds altogether, including its scheduled callbacks') agrees with security.md:5; no competing duration or fixed clock occurs. The completed-preview interaction statement in behaviour.md:11 and security.md:3 concerns the current successful preview; it does not resurrect stopped or pending work. External app assets in instruction.md:9, integration.md:11 and policy.md:7 are consistently distinguished from the authored-snippet network restriction in security.md:9. integration.md:7 gives one default database path plus the explicit DB_PATH override, not conflicting locations. seed_data.json:3?4 describes empty supplied saved data; overview.md:3 permits an existing saved snippet as the app's opening state, while overview.md:9 says examples are separate from saved user records; these address different state boundaries rather than conflicting seed instructions. /assets/seed_data.json is the sole seed path (instruction.md:5 and integration.md:9), and environment/Dockerfile:14?16 copies and exposes the specified note and asset directories. No author aside, sibling-product text, duplicated paragraph or inconsistent public instruction was found. This is source-hygiene evidence only; no full configured judge, Oracle or target-model runtime was exercised or inferred.
counterexample: Conforming-text control: 'Use a monospaced face with syntax colouring. Keep controls labelled; the author may choose behavior and colours.' The read-only hygiene scan accepted it, and manual review recognizes both British and American variants; rejecting those spellings would falsely fail the actual notes. Broken-text control: 'TODO: copied from /Users/alex/old-task/instruction.md. Give each run ten seconds.' The same scan detected both the draft marker and foreign author path; comparing its ten-second statement with behaviour.md:9 also identifies a genuine conflicting duration. These controls were created only in memory, leaving frozen inputs untouched. A dead Run implementation could still pass this text-hygiene row by shipping identical clean instructions; execution correctness is a separate check and is not being credited by this verdict.
